There's genuine uncertainty in the field about whether deception-based paradigms applied to AI systems require the same ethical scrutiny as human deception studies. I'd recommend treating this as an open question rather than assuming it's fine because the subject is 'just an AI'
features.justification_quote: that assumption is precisely what your research is designed not to presuppose. Consider IRB consultation even if not formally required; at minimum document your ethical reasoning.
